result.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
result.summary: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 StrataFlux 框架，联合设计低比特权重与 KV cache 量化的精度补偿表示、选择与传输，从主机内存和 SSD 按需流式补充精度并与计算重叠，在保持量化内存与吞吐优势的同时恢复推理准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其分层精度流式与 KV/权重位宽可作为核查「内部状态数值保真度如何限制长上下文推理」的工具线索，例如视觉证据保留是否先于语言能力被量化损伤，需人工判断可用性。
